title: Is it true that every graph whose vertices have odd degree greater than one contains a cycle of length 2^(n) for some n
exact_target: Must every finite graph with all vertex degrees odd and at least three contain a cycle whose length is a power of two?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3100012 (AMR-030-0012). CC BY 4.0.
Benny Sudakov and Jacques Verstraete, Cycle Lengths in Sparse Graphs (2007), abstract and section 1.3, pp. 1 and 3--4.
